# WorkBuddy Skill Atlas

> Search public Agent Skills and adapt reviewed workflows for WorkBuddy. Every catalog record links to an immutable GitHub commit. Indexed content is not automatically trusted or installed.

The public catalog currently indexes 21,818 Skills. Use it to narrow a search,
then inspect the linked source, license, and permissions before installation.

Release ZIPs are accompanied by a `SHA256SUMS` asset for offline integrity verification.

## Use the catalog

- Web search: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/
- Chinese search: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/zh-CN.html

- Human-readable reviewed package index: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/packages.html
- Reviewed package JSON Schema: https://sandbaseai.github.io/workbuddy-skill/packages-schema.json
- Each reviewed package record includes `source_url`, pinned `sha`, `download_url`, `asset`, `download_command`, and `checksum_url`.
- If a query has no catalog match, use the Atlas empty-state link or [GitHub's current `SKILL.md` code search](https://github.com/search?q=filename%3ASKILL.md&type=code); this is discovery only and does not install or trust external code automatically.

- Catalog metadata includes `catalog_sha256`, a SHA-256 fingerprint of the published catalog bytes.

## Safety and provenance

The Atlas stores metadata, immutable source links, compatibility signals, and conservative static review signals. A clean signal is not a security guarantee. Review the original license, instructions, bundled resources, scripts, network behavior, and permissions before adapting or installing any Skill.

## Install a reviewed package

Use a package's `asset` value from `packages.json` in the following command, then verify the ZIP before importing it into WorkBuddy under **Experts · Skills · Connectors → Skills → Add Skill**:

```bash
mkdir -p workbuddy-download
gh release download --repo sandbaseai/workbuddy-skill \
  --pattern '<asset>' --pattern SHA256SUMS \
  --dir workbuddy-download --clobber
cd workbuddy-download && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
```

For the complete package-set check, run `python3 scripts/verify_release.py
workbuddy-download` from a local repository checkout; it also rejects extra
WorkBuddy ZIPs that are absent from `SHA256SUMS`.

The human-readable package page exposes the exact `download_command` for every reviewed package. Do not install a catalog-only record as if it were a reviewed package; inspect its immutable source first.

## Local query

Clone the repository and run:

```bash
python3 scripts/query_catalog.py research --security no-static-flags --source-context primary-looking --min-score 80 --unique --sort score --limit 10
```

For the same review-oriented defaults, use `python3 scripts/query_catalog.py research --high-signal --limit 10`.

Use `--json` for machine-readable results. Search terms are combined, so every term must match the repository, path, inferred skill name, metadata, or full catalog ID. Atlas filters are available for WorkBuddy package availability, WorkBuddy status, static review state, minimum score, unique blob SHA, and result ordering. The local CLI also accepts `--package-status reviewed` or `--package-status catalog-only`; reviewed results include the direct Release ZIP URL and a copy-ready GitHub CLI command, exposed as `workbuddy_package_url` and `workbuddy_download_command` in JSON.

## Adapt a reviewed result

```bash
python3 scripts/adapt_skill.py \
  --catalog-id 'github:owner/repository:path/to/SKILL.md' \
  --display-name-zh '中文名称' \
  --display-name-en 'English name' \
  --description-zh '中文说明' \
  --description-en 'English description' \
  --author 'Original author; WorkBuddy adapter' \
  --source-license 'MIT'
```

The adapter does not execute downloaded content. It records provenance, applies size and path limits, statically scans instructions and referenced scripts, and packages referenced resources from the same immutable commit.
